description: Exploring the Horde Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Requirements: - Obtain Instructions from Nazgrel - Speak with Vol'jin - Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof - Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
name: Exploring the Horde
